nodes.label: Pairwise Feature Relationships Matrix
nodes.description: 8x8 pairwise scatterplot matrix of top features (sync_d, sync_c, mfcc_3_std, mfcc_10_mean, mfcc_11_mean, mfcc_7_std, f0_range, mfcc_4_std). Diagonal shows KDE distributions; off-diagonal shows scatter plots. Most features show weak/no linear correlation.

metadata.finding: Most audio features and sync metrics are largely uncorrelated, suggesting complex multivariate relationships underlie lip-sync quality
